main_text.l: 2. Is motus potest esse continuus, qui & perfectus
est, & in quo nulla occurrit oppositio, nulla inter-
cedit quies media. Huiusmodi autem motus est cir-
cularis, atq; is solus. Igitur solus motus circularis po-
test esse continuus.
Vtrum idem motus circularis &
continuus sit primus?
Imo, idq; demonstratur.
1. Omnis motus localis aut est circularis, aut re-
ctus, aut reflexus, aut mixtus. Atqui ex his circula-
ris & rectus priores sunt reflexo itèq; mixto, prae-
terea ex illis duobus circularis prior est recto. Igi-
tur motus circularis erit motus primus. Minoris pos-
terius membrum, uidelicet quòd circularis motus
sit prior recto, ita probatur: Motus rectus est im-
perfectus & corruptus. Talis autem non est motus
circularis. Igitur motus circularis praestat recto. Ma-
ior probatur: Imperfectus est motus rectus: quia cum
non possit dari motus rectus infinitus (propterea
quòd neq; linea infinita esse potest, per quam talis
motus diduceretur,) semper potest illi aliqua acce-
dere additio. Corruptus autem est motus rectus: quia
ad terminum magnitudinis cum perucnerit, ibi c s-
sat. In motum autem circularem nihil horum com-
petere, per se manifestum est.
2. Motus qui potest esse perpetuus, prior est eo
qui non potest esse perpetuus. Motus autem circularis

A small mark "ssat" near the middle of paragraph 1 is a fragment of a word ("ibi c ssat"), rendered as printed; the reading "ibi cessat" is likely but I did not read it clearly, so the text is left as the scan shows. The last line "laris" at the right of the foot is the start of a word broken at the page end ("circu-laris") and continues on the next page, so it is copied as a fragment. The word "perucnerit" is as printed. The small mark at the bottom centre is an ornament, not text. Words in paragraph 2 near the page edge are partly faint; the transcription follows the most legible reading. Heading "Vtrum idem motus circularis & continuus sit primus?" is set centred in larger type. The page has a typographic ornament with no text, and the lowercase line "Imo,idq;" is printed with an italic ligature. Reading of "ibi c ssat" is uncertain and marked here rather than in the text.
